source: NCSC Cyber Essentials Requirements for IT Infrastructure v3.2

groups.title: Scope
groups.overview: Your assessment and certification should cover the whole of the IT infrastructure used to carry out your organisation's business.

groups.title: Accounts used by third parties and managed infrastructure
Firewalls
groups.overview: To make sure that only secure and necessary network services can be accessed from the internet.

groups.title: Secure configuration
groups.overview: Ensure that computers and network devices are properly configured to reduce vulnerabilities and provide only the services required to fulfil their role.

groups.title: Security update management
groups.overview: Ensure that devices and software are not vulnerable to known security issues for which fixes are available.

groups.title: User access control
groups.overview: Ensure that user accounts are assigned to authorised individuals only and provide access to only those applications, computers and networks the user needs to carry out their role.

groups.title: Malware protection
groups.overview: To restrict execution of known malware and untrusted software, from causing damage or accessing data.

controls.label: Firewalls
controls.statement: You must protect every device in scope with a correctly configured firewall (or network device with firewall functionality).

controls.label: Change default administrative passwords
controls.statement: Change default administrative passwords to a strong and unique password, or disable remote administrative access entirely.

controls.label: Prevent internet access to administrative interface
controls.statement: Prevent access to the administrative interface from the internet, unless there is a clear and documented business need and the interface is protected by multi-factor authentication or an IP allow list.

controls.label: Block unauthenticated inbound connections
controls.statement: Block unauthenticated inbound connections by default.

controls.label: Approve and document inbound firewall rules
controls.statement: Ensure inbound firewall rules are approved and documented by an authorised person, including the business need.

controls.label: Remove unnecessary firewall rules
controls.statement: Remove or disable unnecessary firewall rules when they are no longer needed.

controls.label: Software firewall on untrusted networks
controls.statement: Use a software firewall on devices which are used on untrusted networks, such as public wifi hotspots.

controls.label: Secure configuration
controls.statement: Your organisation must proactively manage your computers and network devices to ensure they are securely configured.

controls.label: Remove unnecessary user accounts
controls.statement: Remove and disable unnecessary user accounts, such as guest accounts and administrative accounts that will not be used.

controls.label: Change default or guessable passwords
controls.statement: Change any default or guessable account passwords.

controls.label: Remove unnecessary software
controls.statement: Remove or disable unnecessary software, including applications, system utilities and network services.

controls.label: Disable auto-run features
controls.statement: Disable any auto-run feature which allows file execution without user authorisation.

controls.label: Authenticate users before access
controls.statement: Ensure users are authenticated before allowing them access to organisational data or services.

controls.label: Device locking controls
controls.statement: Ensure appropriate device locking controls for users that are physically present.

controls.label: Protect against brute-force attacks
controls.statement: Protect device unlocking credentials against brute-force attacks using throttling (no more than 10 guesses in 5 minutes) or lockout after 10 unsuccessful attempts.

controls.label: Security update management
controls.statement: You must make sure that all software in scope is kept up to date.

controls.label: Licensed and supported software
controls.statement: All software on in-scope devices must be licensed and supported.

controls.label: Remove unsupported software
controls.statement: Remove unsupported software from devices or remove from scope by using a defined sub-set that prevents all traffic to/from the internet.

controls.label: Enable automatic updates
controls.statement: Have automatic updates enabled where possible.

controls.label: Apply critical vulnerability patches within 14 days
controls.statement: Apply updates that fix critical or high-risk vulnerabilities (CVSS v3 score of 7 or above) within 14 days of release.

controls.label: User access control
controls.statement: Your organisation must be in control of your user accounts and the access privileges that allow access to your organisational data and services.

controls.label: Process to create and approve user accounts
controls.statement: Have in place a process to create and approve user accounts.

controls.label: Authenticate with unique credentials
controls.statement: Authenticate users with unique credentials before granting access to applications or devices.

controls.label: Remove inactive user accounts
controls.statement: Remove or disable user accounts when they are no longer required, for example when a user leaves the organisation or after a defined period of account inactivity.

controls.label: Implement multi-factor authentication
controls.statement: Implement multi-factor authentication where available. Authentication to cloud services must always use MFA.

controls.label: Separate administrative accounts
controls.statement: Use separate accounts to perform administrative activities only, with no emailing, web browsing or other standard user activities.

controls.label: Remove unnecessary special access privileges
controls.statement: Remove or disable special access privileges when no longer required.

controls.label: Protect passwords against brute-force guessing
controls.statement: Protect passwords against brute-force guessing using MFA, throttling (no more than 10 guesses in 5 minutes), or lockout after 10 unsuccessful attempts.

controls.label: Technical controls for password quality
controls.statement: Use technical controls to manage password quality: MFA, minimum 12 characters with no max, or minimum 8 characters with no max plus automatic blocking of common passwords.

controls.label: MFA for administrative and internet-accessible accounts
controls.statement: Use multi-factor authentication to give administrative accounts extra security, and accounts that are accessible from the internet.

controls.label: Malware protection
controls.statement: You must make sure that a malware protection mechanism is active on all devices in scope, using at least one of the following options.

controls.label: Anti-malware software configuration
controls.statement: Anti-malware software must be configured to be updated in line with vendor recommendations, prevent malware from running, prevent execution of malicious code, and prevent connections to malicious websites.

controls.label: Application allow listing
controls.statement: Application allow listing: only approved applications restricted by code signing are allowed to execute. Maintain a current list of approved applications; users must not be able to install unsigned or invalid-signature applications.
